name: @cliangdev/creative-render-job
description: T3 headless render job: renders a Conductor Creative to upload-ready PNGs in Playwright Chromium, checks each frame with the in-page assertions, and hands the result to a pluggable transport (see transport.mjs). Kept as its own package.json so playwright is not a dependency of conductor-creative/ itself (the frontend consumes that package and must stay dependency-free).
